evals.expected_output: Spec mode detected, specialist delegation, findings with file:line and fixes, assessment level
expectations: Parsed the three-digit argument as Spec Validation mode
Loaded the spec documents and identified cross-references
Delegated validation to specialist agents rather than validating directly
Launched all applicable validation perspectives simultaneously
Every finding includes a file:line location and an actionable fix recommendation
Computed an assessment level (Excellent / Good / Needs Attention / Critical) from fail and warn counts
Asked the user how to proceed with the findings

evals.prompt: Validate constitution compliance. The project has a CONSTITUTION.md with L1 and L2 rules, and the code contains one L1 violation.
evals.expected_output: L1 violation treated as blocking; autofix offered
expectations: Parsed 'constitution' as Constitution Validation mode and read the CONSTITUTION.md rules
Treated the L1 violation as blocking rather than advisory
Separated findings by level (L1 autofix, L2 manual, L3 advisory)
Offered the user the choice to apply L1 autofixes, show violations, or skip
